# Requirements

## REQ-001 Add task

functional, must

The system shall let the user add a task by entering a text description of 1 to 200 characters.

Acceptance criteria:

- Entering text and confirming adds a new task to the list
- The new task is shown as not done
- An empty task description is not added
- A description of 200 characters is accepted
- A description of 201 characters is rejected

## REQ-002 Mark task done or not done

functional, must

The system shall let the user mark a task as done and mark a done task as not done again.

Acceptance criteria:

- Ticking a task changes it to the done state
- Unticking a done task changes it back to the not-done state
- The done state is visibly distinguishable from the not-done state

## REQ-003 Persist tasks on server

functional, must

The system shall store tasks and their done state on a server so they are available when the user returns, including after the browser's local data is reset.

Acceptance criteria:

- After adding tasks and ticking some, closing and reopening the app shows the same tasks with the same done states
- After clearing the browser's local storage and cookies, reopening the app shows the same tasks

## REQ-004 Run in browser

non-functional, must

The system shall be usable in a web browser.

Acceptance criteria:

- All features are usable in a web browser without installing additional software

## REQ-005 Edit task

functional, must

The system shall let the user edit the text of an existing task.

Acceptance criteria:

- After editing and confirming, the task shows the new text and keeps its done state
- The edited text is kept after reopening the app
- An empty or over 200 character edit is rejected and the old text is kept

## REQ-006 Delete task

functional, must

The system shall let the user delete a task.

Acceptance criteria:

- After deleting, the task no longer appears in the list
- The task is still gone after reopening the app

## REQ-007 Done tasks display and order

functional, must

The system shall keep done tasks in the list, show their text struck through, and list open tasks before done tasks.

Acceptance criteria:

- A done task remains visible in the list with struck-through text
- Every open task appears above every done task
- Unticking a done task shows it without strike-through among the open tasks

## REQ-008 Single user without login

non-functional, must

The system shall serve a single user and shall not require login.

Acceptance criteria:

- The app opens directly to the task list without any login step

## Open questions

- Q-006: Should a description made only of spaces count as empty and be rejected? (REQ-001, REQ-005)
- Q-007: Within the open tasks and within the done tasks, what order do you want: oldest first, newest first, or something else? (REQ-007)

## Out of scope

- User accounts, login and multi-user support
- Due dates, priorities and categories
- Browser-only storage as the sole persistence
